notes.title: Summer's End
notes.content:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280850/Swing_Striker/"][/dynamiclink]

You know it belongs on your Steam wishlist! ☝️☝️☝️☝️

Hey there, Strikers!

Summer's almost gone 🚪, but it was full of events and kept us occupied for sure. We traveled a lot and took the Swing Striker with us! One such travel led us to Dallas for DreamHack back in May!

Various folks visited, including esports stars both established and emerging. Their appreciation was humbling! We also got some vital feedback that will help us improve the game further.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/c22bf1c11ad303a14120e558042555884b100685.png

So what's been going on in the project?

We're still deep in development — sanding off the rough edges, testing new mechanics 🛠️, and occasionally asking ourselves “What if the ball had feelings?” 🤔 We don’t know where that thread leads, but we’re not ruling anything out.

Right now, we're exploring ways to complete the project and secure funding (translation: we’re juggling design docs and pitch decks like hot potatoes). But rest assured, the world will get Swing Striker. It’s just too ridiculous not to exist.

Our dedication to present the world with the answer to the “What if soccer... but unhinged?” question remains unwavering. We hope that soon enough you will also be able to grab a controller, test your reflexes, and scream like a champion when you accidentally score 🥳.

Stay flexible!
Giant Fox Studios 🦊

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/72d53f25be24cf843d5a92844d52d4b99d208b9e.gif

Stay tuned and remember to

notes.title: Swing Striker is Getting Bigger and Better!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/fb517ff4840cde8da1c3d7c53ee81e808f857fad.png

Impatient to play? We hear you! Swing Striker’s development team has expanded in order to provide quality content at an even quicker pace. With this new approach, our team has been able to implement some new features which should create hours of exciting content for you all to play! 

Some of our new features:
- A longer single-player mode with awesome platforming levels and an intricate story  
- A DeathMatch Mode which is pure, glorious carnage and fun
- Unique special character abilities - For example, Squidkicks can now #ShootDaBoot!

[previewyoutube=wyMA7ranmB4;full][/previewyoutube]
   
We really appreciate the feedback we’ve received from our Beta Testers and have released a brand new demo version that addresses many of the issues you brought to our attention! We will have more updates coming soon. We hope that you continue to play and tell us what you think during this exciting time in our development!

Join our Discord for the latest info about the game and to chat with us directly about your ideas on how we can improve Swing Striker! https://discord.com/invite/TMuEhveS3f

notes.title: New Costumes and Some Bug Squashing
notes.content:
WOW, what an awesome week this has been! We've been reading through every review and watching all of the videos. Thank you so much for all of the amazing feedback given.

We're already making improvements to the game based on what you've said! A new build of Swing Striker just went live a few moments ago. Here's what's new!
- Fixed most critical issues (there are still some issues if you play multiple matches in a row
- Made it easier to unlock skins/costumes and they sync online now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/e0a92cdb4cd9416dba62d21e5d00f9608211283c.png

Here's what we're working on next:
- Fixing remaining major bugs
- Adding a rematch button for private online matches
- Adding an option to play against a bot in competitive mode

If you run into any bugs while playing, please press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+B to report a bug to us right in-game and put it in your review over at the website. It's a HUGE help for us!

Also, there's a Swing Striker community game night on G.Round at 10am EST today- https://www.twitch.tv/gameroundco

A few of the developers will be there, so come by, chat with us, and see if you have what it takes to beat us at our own game!

notes.title: And We're Live!
notes.content:
Why hello everyone! Thank you for caring enough about our game to read this! We really appreciate it and want to do everything we can to make it as awesome for you as possible. Now without further ado, introducing, SWING STRIKER! :D

https://media.giphy.com/media/lOahmXh39CZm9wzlDX/giphy.gif

Oh man, where do we begin? If you think Swing Striker looks familiar, it might be because you played it 8 years ago as a Flash game! Originally called Swing Soccer, the game was created while the team was working at bored.com and did extremely well after PewDiePie did a let's play review of it almost a decade ago. Here's the OG version for comparison on where we are now:

[previewyoutube=HTfdvoIaBhI;full][/previewyoutube]

Since then we've been busy with a whole bunch of other projects for clients or indie game releases and full time jobs. For the past year and a half or so though we've been working on rereleasing Swing Soccer in the full glory we always wanted it to be, giving it a full reskin, epic backstory, and gamepad controls that make the game WAY more enjoyable than the Flash version ever could have. 

https://media.giphy.com/media/MEWgNSnv4jlvxaFm0l/source.gif

We've made great progress on the game, have shown a demo at quite a few expos before quarantine hit, and now getting ready to release the game on Steam later this year! We're working on getting a free demo of Swing Striker up for the Steam Game Festival in June. Wishlist it now to make sure you get notified when it's available!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/f3f947bf6ef498823c2ec70ae54feab54b08853c.png

Thanks again for reading and being interested in our game! We can't wait to hear what you think of the game when you play. Remember the wishlist it now if you haven't yet! www.bit.ly/swingstriker

- The Giant Fox Studios Team
